verdict.rationale: Semgrep has no first-party natural-language command interface. Its core operation runs through CLI commands and YAML rules ([semgrep-docs-27], [semgrep-docs-4]). A documented official MCP server ([semgrep-probe-3]) lets an external AI agent drive Semgrep from natural-language prompts, so this is indirect, agent-mediated support. Semgrep's own AI features cover detection and triage of findings, not taking commands ([semgrep-gh-3], [semgrep-docs-48]). Missing for 10: a native natural-language command or chat interface in the CLI or AppSec Platform, documentation of natural-language workflows through the MCP server, hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation.
